name: coral-skills
description: Build Coral agents and integrate applications with Coral Server

interface.shortDescription: Build Coral agents and integrate apps with Coral Server.
interface.longDescription: Write Coral agents from the Koog template, integrate applications with Coral Server's HTTP API through session requests and signed custom-tool callbacks, configure and deploy the server, and debug sessions during development. Includes a mirror of the official Coral docs.
defaultPrompt: Build a Coral agent around these MCP servers, using the Koog template as a reference.
Integrate this app with Coral: create sessions and receive results through custom tools.
Deploy Coral Server with this application's agents.
